description: Umbrella PRD for the trust substrate: matters + viewer baseline, citation UI/model, verification gate, failure UX, and minimal provenance.

userStories.title: Matter + document viewer baseline
userStories.description: Create matters, upload PDFs, and view them with page navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: User can create a matter and upload the PDFs from pack_01_clean/docs/.
Document list shows processing state (even if it is "uploaded" only).
PDF viewer renders any uploaded PDF and supports page navigation.

userStories.title: Citation chips -> click-to-highlight
userStories.description: Clicking a citation chip opens the correct doc/page and highlights the cited region using anchor scaffolding.
acceptanceCriteria: In pack_01_clean, selecting a seeded row with citations shows citation chips.
Clicking a chip opens the target PDF and highlights the cited region (using anchors).
Viewer shows snippet text and snippet hash next to the highlight.

userStories.title: Canonical citation model + citations API
userStories.description: Store citations as canonical objects and expose them via an API used by the viewer and report table.
acceptanceCriteria: Report rows store citations as IDs (not free text).
GET /citations/:id returns {document_id, page_number, polygons, snippet, snippet_hash}.
Viewer uses only this API for evidence display.

userStories.title: Verification gate + row status transitions
userStories.description: Fail-closed verification that blocks export by default when citations fail.
acceptanceCriteria: For a known-good seeded row in pack_01_clean, verifier passes and row becomes needs_review.
For a known-bad row (inject a mismatching snippet hash), verifier fails and row becomes citation_failed.
UI surfaces citation check failed and blocks export by default (override toggle optional).

userStories.title: Failure journeys as first-class UX
userStories.description: Missing docs, OCR quality warnings, and citation mismatch are explicit and actionable.
acceptanceCriteria: pack_02_missing_rea produces rows tagged missing_input with a clear missing referenced docs list.
pack_06_noisy_scans_rotated_page surfaces extraction/OCR quality warnings at doc level (even if simulated early).
Citation mismatch shows a visible error and a user action: flag citation wrong.

userStories.title: Provenance and traceability
userStories.description: Capture minimal provenance that answers what produced a row and allow trace export.
acceptanceCriteria: Every run and row stores agent_bundle_version (prompt versions, retrieval pipeline version).
Store model + prompt version + retrieved chunk IDs for each row generation.
Ability to export a run trace JSON for a single run.
